name: Update SSD client
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca 'set -e; cd /mnt/nvme11n1/artemisprime/Upload-Assistant-wastaken; podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml pull; podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d --no-build upload-assistant-wastaken; sleep 3; podman ps --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}"; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:12346/api/health'
description: Pull the published image and restart the Clementine SSD Upload Assistant client.
